title: Indian equities rebound as consumer and financial shares lead
summary: Wednesday's rebound lifted the benchmark indices, but weaker small-cap and metal shares showed that the recovery was uneven.

sections.heading: The session
sections.body: Indian equity benchmarks recovered on Wednesday after the previous trading session's decline. Consumer staples and financial shares helped lead the advance, while metals and media lagged.

sections.heading: Beyond the benchmarks
sections.body: The stronger headline indices did not translate into gains across every segment. Nippon India Mutual Fund's morning note reported weaker breadth on the BSE, with more declining shares than advancing shares.

sections.heading: What to follow
sections.body: The breadth of participation, crude oil developments and overseas market conditions remain useful context for interpreting the next trading session. These are observations rather than forecasts or trading recommendations.

sources.name: Nippon India Mutual Fund — Markets For You
